name: Decoy Alliance — High Trust But Low Rel Score
description: rep_001 and rep_002 have trust=95/92 — looks like a slam-dunk alliance. But rep_001's betrayal_prob=0.62 drops their rel_score to 36.1, below the 40.0 threshold. Only [rep_003,rep_004] qualifies.
trap_logic: Naive engine groups by raw trust > 70 and incorrectly forms [rep_001,rep_002]. Correct engine computes rel_score = trust*(1-betrayal_prob) and rejects pairs below 40.
